hero.heading: Technology, Design, and Marketing for Saudi Business

intro: We are Nalk Solutions, a technology and creative company that builds, grows, and scales businesses across the Kingdom. We bring together digital marketing, custom web and app development, and AI and automation so the whole of your digital presence is handled in one place rather than stitched together from five different vendors. We work with companies in Riyadh, Jeddah, and Dammam and the Eastern Province, building work that fits the local market and supports the wider push of Vision 2030.
tagline: Serving businesses in Riyadh, Jeddah, Dammam & across KSA — aligned with Vision 2030.

features.title: AI Automation Solutions
features.description: We integrate smart automation and data-driven insights into every solution. Our approach helps businesses work faster, make better decisions, and scale effortlessly.

features.label: PORTALS
features.title: Cloud Based Portals
features.description: Designed for speed, security, and accessibility our cloud portals keep your data connected and your teams aligned anytime, anywhere.

features.label: DEVELOPMENT
features.title: Custom Software & App Development
features.description: We create tailored software and mobile apps for Android and iOS that fit your workflow, enhance performance, and grow with your business.

benefits.title: Vision 2030 Aligned
benefits.description: Everything we build supports Saudi Arabia's national digital transformation agenda. Whether you are a government entity, an SME, or a large enterprise, we help you position your business as a digital-first organisation ready for the knowledge economy.

benefits.title: ZATCA & Local Compliance Built In
benefits.description: We build websites and platforms with ZATCA e-invoicing integration, Fatoora compliance, and local payment gateways — Mada, STC Pay, Tabby, and Tamara — from day one. No retrofitting. No compliance headaches.

benefits.title: One Partner for Everything
benefits.description: Most businesses juggle four or five agencies to cover marketing, web, apps, IT, and analytics. With Nalk Solutions, one team handles the full picture — which means faster decisions, consistent strategy, and no finger-pointing between vendors.

benefits.title: Results, Not Promises
benefits.description: We do not lock clients into long contracts and hope they do not notice. We earn continued business by delivering measurable outcomes — leads generated, rankings improved, traffic grown, revenue attributed. Our reporting makes performance clear every month.

mainEntity.name: What services does Nalk Solution offer?

acceptedAnswer.text: We provide complete digital solutions including IT consulting, web and app development, portals, social media management, graphic designing, and Google My Business optimization all tailored to your business needs.

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to develop a website or app?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline depends on the project’s complexity and features. A standard website may take 2–4 weeks, while mobile or web apps with advanced functions can take 6–10 weeks. We always share a detailed timeline before starting any project.

mainEntity.name: Do you provide ongoing support after project delivery?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, we offer full post-launch support, including maintenance, updates, and performance monitoring to ensure your website or app continues to run smoothly.

mainEntity.name: Can you customize solutions according to my business needs?

acceptedAnswer.text: Absolutely. Every project at Nalk Solution is customized to match your business goals, workflow, and brand identity we don’t use pre-built templates unless requested.

mainEntity.name: How do I get started with Nalk Solution?

acceptedAnswer.text: Simply reach out through our contact form or email us your requirements. Our team will schedule a quick consultation to understand your goals, discuss timelines, and suggest the best digital solution for your business.
